name: Meals
description: Plan the week's meals for your household, then shop and cook from the plan.

screens.label: Meals
screens.description: The Meals page, with tabs for Plan, Shopping list, Pantry, Household and Log. Plan shows the meal plan day by day as Moss writes it, with tonight's dinner on top, and an empty state until a plan exists.

screens.label: Shopping list
screens.description: The shopping list by store section, with amounts to buy, where each line came from, the plan's Pantry mode, a You have this group for what the Pantry covers, and Bought.

screens.label: Pantry
screens.description: What the household has on hand, with a find box, an amount for each item (Some when there is no amount), and add, edit and remove. Removing an item offers Undo. A rail lists the Staples.

screens.label: Staples
screens.description: Things always on hand, such as salt, oil and water. Staples never go on the shopping list and count as on hand when Moss plans.

screens.label: Recipe
screens.description: One planned meal as a recipe, with who eats it, the ingredients beside the original line, the method, and under it the cooking controls: servings in halves, Mark cooked with Undo, a star rating and a favourite toggle for each person. Opened from a meal on the Plan tab.

screens.label: Household
screens.description: Who eats, each person's meals of the day, Never serve list, preferences and optional calorie target.

screens.label: Meals settings
screens.description: Units (US or metric) and the default Pantry mode.

screens.label: Log
screens.description: What you ate on a day, with calories and macros against your daily target. Log a meal by typing it, correct or delete an entry, and retry an estimate that is stuck.

screens.label: Swap a meal
screens.description: Three replacement recipes for one meal, each already checked for Safety against who eats it. Choose one to replace the meal; the shopping list rebuilds and keeps its ticks. Opened from Swap on a meal in the Plan tab.

screens.label: New plan
screens.description: Start a meal plan: the first day, how many days, the Pantry mode and an optional note about what you want. Moss then writes the days one by one on the Plan tab.

features.description: Add or change household members through Moss.
Ask Moss to plan any number of days up to 28. Days are written one by one. Stop, resume, or retry one day.

Every meal is checked against each eater's Never serve list. The check only says nothing listed was found outright, never that a meal is safe, and every result, pass or fail, reminds you to double check. Packaged or branded ingredients carry a check-the-label note.
Add to the list, I bought everything, and undo through Moss.

A plan's Pantry mode decides how Moss uses the Pantry. Ignore the Pantry lists everything. Use what I have subtracts what the Pantry covers from the shopping list and leans toward ingredients on hand. Cook only from what I have also rewrites any recipe that needs something that is neither in the Pantry nor a Staple. Add to the Pantry through the page or through Moss.
Ask Moss what is in the Pantry, add or change an item or a Staple, or remove one and undo it.
Log what you ate through Moss. Moss estimates calories and macros, answers what you ate on a day or over a range, corrects an entry, and deletes one after asking.

Change a meal's servings in halves, and the recipe and shopping list follow. Mark cooked takes what the recipe used out of the Pantry, never below zero, shows what it took, and offers Undo and an offer to log your portion in Log. Ask Moss to say you cooked a meal, or to undo it.
Rate a recipe from one to five stars for each person who ate it. One star keeps that recipe out of new plans that include that person, unless you ask for it by name.
Mark a recipe as a favourite for a person, and ask Moss to place a favourite into a meal slot. Placing runs the Never serve check first and refuses a locked meal.

Lock a written meal so Regenerate keeps it. Regenerate the whole plan, one day or one meal; locked, cooked and text meals stay, and the confirmation says how many meals will be replaced. Shopping list ticks survive.
Swap a meal: ask for three replacement recipes, each checked for Safety first, and choose one. Moss can start and finish a swap from chat.

assistantActionFamilies.label: Meal planning
assistantActionFamilies.description: Plan meals, manage the household, list, Pantry and cooking.

assistantActionFamilies.label: Meal logging
assistantActionFamilies.description: Log what you ate and correct or delete a logged meal.

assistantTools.name: meals.kitchen.get
assistantTools.description: Read the Meals kitchen: units, default Pantry mode, every household member with their meals of the day, Never serve list, preferences and targets, and the Shared or Solo rule for each meal. A new account shows one member named You and the default settings.

assistantTools.name: meals.kitchen.save
assistantTools.description: Change kitchen settings: units, the default Pantry mode for new plans, and Shared or Solo rules per meal. Each slot rule given replaces the stored rule for that meal name; other rules stay.

defaultPantryMode.description: ignore: plan without the Pantry. prefer: use what is on hand where it fits. only: plan only from what is on hand.

slotName.description: Meal of the day, for example dinner.

soloWeekdays.description: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday) when each person eats this meal on their own. Empty means shared every day.

usualTime.description: Usual time as HH:MM, or null.

assistantTools.name: meals.household.save
assistantTools.description: Add or change a household member. Leave memberId out to add someone (name required). Restrictions are strict Never serve items; preferences are soft likes and dislikes. Null clears an optional field.

memberId.description: Member to change. Leave out to add a new member.

linkedAccountEmail.description: Their Moss account email, if they have one.

mealPattern.description: Meals of the day this person eats. Defaults to breakfast, lunch and dinner.

restrictions.description: Never serve: allergies, diets and foods this person must not be served, for example peanuts or vegetarian.

assistantTools.name: meals.household.remove
assistantTools.description: Remove a household member. The self member cannot be removed.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.create
assistantTools.description: Start a meal plan of 1 to 28 days from a start date. Moss writes the days one at a time in the background, checking every meal against each eater's Never serve list and calorie target, and returns the plan at once with its days pending. Call meals.plan.get to follow progress. Reusing an idempotency key returns the plan that key already made. When the user names only some meals, such as dinners, pass mealTypes with just those. Planning every meal then would be wrong.

startDate.description: First day of the plan, YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's own calendar.

pantryMode.description: Leave out to use the kitchen default.

requestText.description: What the user asked for, in their words, for example quick dinners and more fish.

mealTypes.description: Which meals to plan, for example ["dinner"] when the user asks only for dinners. Leave out to plan every meal the household eats.

allowRepeats.description: True lets a dish from the last seven days come back.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh value per request, so a retried call does not start a second plan.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.get
assistantTools.description: Read a meal plan by its id, or the newest plan that covers a date: each day's status, its meals, who eats them, Safety results and calorie fit.

date.description: Find the newest plan that includes this day.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.current
assistantTools.description: Read the meal plan the Plan tab shows for a date: the plan that covers it, else the next one to start, else the newest. Returns plan null when nothing is planned. Same fields as meals.plan.get.

date.description: Today in the user's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD.

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.control
assistantTools.description: Stop a plan that is being written, resume a stopped or paused plan where it left off, retry one day that failed, or regenerate. A retry keeps the day's finished meals and rewrites only the rest. Name the day by dayId or date. Retrying a day on a stopped plan resumes the whole plan, so later unwritten days are written too. A retry asked for while another day is being written waits its turn. Regenerate replaces written and failed recipe meals with new ones and never touches locked meals, cooked meals or text meals. It covers the whole plan, one day (dayId or date) or one meal (mealId). The plan's replaceable count says how many meals a whole-plan regenerate would replace. Shopping list ticks survive, and only lines whose amount changed show a new amount.
assistantTools.actionLabel: Stop, resume, retry or regenerate a meal plan

assistantTools.name: meals.plan.delete
assistantTools.description: Delete a meal plan with all its days and meals.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.get
assistantTools.description: Read one planned meal as a recipe: steps, ingredients scaled to the servings, check-the-label notes, and each eater's portion, Safety result and calorie fit.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.cooked
assistantTools.description: Mark a planned meal cooked. It takes what the recipe used, scaled to the servings, out of the Pantry without taking any item below zero, and returns what changed, an undo token for meals.undo, and an offer to log the person's portion. The offer is only an offer: to log it, call meals.log.add with its description and servingNote. A meal can be marked cooked once.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.servings
assistantTools.description: Change how many servings a planned meal cooks, in steps of half a serving from 0.5 to 24, or pass null to go back to the eaters' portions. The recipe amounts and the shopping list follow the new servings.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.rate
assistantTools.description: Rate a meal's recipe from 1 to 5 stars for one or more household members, or pass null stars to clear a rating. One star keeps that recipe out of future plans that include that person, unless a request names the recipe.

assistantTools.name: meals.favourites.edit
assistantTools.description: Add or remove a recipe as one person's favourite (action add or remove, with memberId and recipeId), or place a favourite into a planned meal (action place, with mealId). Placing runs the Never serve check for everyone who eats that meal and refuses when it fails or when the meal is locked. Returns the kitchen, and the meal when one was placed.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.edit
assistantTools.description: Lock or unlock one written recipe meal. A locked meal stays through every Regenerate. Cooked meals and text meals cannot be locked.

assistantTools.name: meals.meal.swap
assistantTools.description: Swap one written or failed recipe meal. request_choices starts three replacement recipes, each checked for Safety before it shows; read the meal to see them as they finish. choose takes a ready choiceId, replaces the meal with it and rebuilds the shopping list. A locked meal can be swapped by asking.

assistantTools.name: meals.list.get
assistantTools.description: Read the shopping list. Lines are grouped by store section and carry the amount the recipes need, the amount to buy, the meals each line is for, whether it is ticked, and whether it is already bought. A line marked notInPlan is ticked but no longer needed by the plan. Returns an empty list before one is built.

assistantTools.name: meals.list.build
assistantTools.description: Build the shopping list from a meal plan, or rebuild it after the plan changed. The same ingredient across meals becomes one line, and amounts round up to what the shop sells. Lines you ticked stay ticked, lines you added stay, and a ticked line the plan no longer needs stays, marked not in the plan.
assistantTools.actionLabel: Build your shopping list from the plan

assistantTools.name: meals.list.edit
assistantTools.description: Add, change, remove, tick or untick shopping lines. add needs a name and takes an optional quantity, unit and store section. update changes a line by lineId, and on a line built from the plan the quantity is the amount to buy. remove returns an undo token. tick and untick take lineId, or lineIds to do several at once.

assistantTools.name: meals.list.bought
assistantTools.description: Mark shopping lines as bought and add them to the Pantry. Without lines it takes every ticked line. Give a line a quantity and unit when you bought a different amount than the list said. Returns an undo token that reverses it.

assistantTools.name: meals.list.clear
assistantTools.description: Remove every line from the shopping list, including lines you added. This cannot be undone.

assistantTools.name: meals.pantry.get
assistantTools.description: Read the Pantry. Items carry a name, an optional amount and unit (no amount means the household has some), and where the item came from. Staples are the things always on hand, such as salt and oil, that never go on the shopping list.

assistantTools.name: meals.pantry.edit
assistantTools.description: Add, change or remove a Pantry item or a Staple. action is add, update or remove. target is item (the default) or staple. add needs a name and takes an optional quantity and unit for an item; no quantity means the household has some. update changes an item by itemId, or renames a Staple by stapleId. Removing an item returns an undo token. Changing the Pantry updates a shopping list that follows a plan.

assistantTools.name: meals.undo
assistantTools.description: Undo the change an undo token names. A removed shopping line or Pantry item comes back, a Bought is reversed, and a Mark cooked puts the meal back to not cooked and its Pantry amounts back. A Pantry amount that was edited after Bought or Mark cooked is left alone and counted as skipped.
assistantTools.actionLabel: Undo a shopping list or Pantry change

assistantTools.name: meals.log.list
assistantTools.description: List logged meals for one day (localDate) or a range of up to 31 days (fromLocalDate and toLocalDate). A single day also returns the day's totals, the self member's daily targets and how the calories compare to the calorie target. Totals count only estimated meals. A meal still being estimated is counted in entriesWithoutEstimate, never as zero.

limit.description: Maximum meals to return, keeping the most recent. Defaults to 200, which is also the ceiling.

assistantTools.name: meals.log.summarize
assistantTools.description: Add up nutrition across a date range of up to 92 days. Meals without an estimate are counted, never treated as zero.

assistantTools.name: meals.log.add
assistantTools.description: Log a meal from a description. The meal is saved at once as pending and Moss estimates calories and macros in the background. Read it again with meals.log.list to see the estimate. A retry with the same idempotencyKey returns the same meal.

consumedAt.description: When the meal was consumed: use an ISO instant with Z or a numeric offset, or an offset-less local date-time interpreted in timeZone. Example: 2026-08-22T20:14:00 with America/Los_Angeles stores 2026-08-23T03:14:00.000Z. DST gaps and folds require an explicit offset.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for an offset-less consumedAt value; for example, 2026-08-22T20:14:00 with America/Los_Angeles stores 2026-08-23T03:14:00.000Z. The host locale takes precedence when available.

mealType.description: Part of the day. Use it when the person names a meal such as lunch and gives no time; Moss stamps a usual time today. consumedAt wins when both are given.

assistantTools.name: meals.log.reestimate
assistantTools.description: Retry the estimate for a meal that is still pending or whose estimate failed. A meal that already has an estimate is left alone. Use meals.log.correct to change one.

entryId.description: Identifier of the meal to re-estimate.

assistantTools.name: meals.log.correct
assistantTools.description: Correct a logged meal's description, serving note, time or one of the foods in it. Pass the expectedRevision from the last read. A stale revision is refused. The meal's totals are recalculated from its foods.

consumedAt.description: When the meal was consumed: use an ISO instant with Z or a numeric offset, or an offset-less local date-time interpreted in timeZone. Example: 2026-08-22T20:14:00 with America/Los_Angeles stores 2026-08-23T03:14:00.000Z. DST gaps and folds require an explicit offset.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for an offset-less consumedAt value; for example, 2026-08-22T20:14:00 with America/Los_Angeles stores 2026-08-23T03:14:00.000Z. The host locale takes precedence when available.

items.description: Entry N corrects the Nth food in the meal; null leaves that food alone. The meal's totals are recalculated from the foods afterwards.

assistantTools.name: meals.log.delete
assistantTools.description: Delete a logged meal.
